entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF98765.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's not what I wanted. I just haven't had a chance to call.
I understand. Sometimes it takes a bit of getting used to. Many customers find that after exploring the VeloFit app's features...
Look, I don't need a tutorial. There was an emergency. My husband was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery right after this thing arrived. It's been the last thing on my mind.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly understand, family comes first. I hope he is recovering well. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.

Thank you for your patience... Okay, I've got it here. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it on December 15th, you are well within that window. I can absolutely process this for you.

Yes, it is. I have just authorized the return. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just pack it back up in the original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund.
I'm glad I could help resolve this for you today. Again, I wish your husband a swift recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
